item.title: Edgefield tax assessor is arrested for allegedly striking resident seeking property info
item.description: The tax assessor for Edgefield County was arrested this month after allegedly striking a woman who came to his office seeking information about her recently purchased home. The post Edgefield tax assessor is arrested for allegedly striking resident seeking property info appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Six Richmond County students named 2025–2026 REACH Scholars
item.description: Six Richmond County School System eighth-graders have been selected as 2025–2026 REACH Scholars, earning each student at least a $10,000 scholarship and ongoing academic support through high school. item.title: Lincoln County to clash with Bowdon in state title game
item.description: After a dominant playoff run that saw them outscore four opponents 185-22, the Lincoln County Red Devils (14-0) are headed to Mercedes-Benz Stadium for the Class A Division II state championship game. item.title: Face-covered suspect sought after bold robbery at Augusta Dollar General
item.description: The Richmond County Sheriff’s Office is searching for a suspect accused of robbing the Dollar General at 2549 Deans Bridge Road on Thursday evening. Investigators say the individual, described as approximately 5’11’’ to 6’02’’ and 180–200 pounds, entered the store wearing a face covering and committed an armed robbery before fleeing the area on foot […] The post Face-covered suspect sought after bold robbery at Augusta Dollar General appeared first on The Augusta Press.
